## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Manhattan, United States. It starts at 1220 Fifth Ave at 103rd St, NY.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The world's most famous metropolis comes under the spotlight at the Museum of the City of New York, which celebrates the city's vibrant past, present, and future.
>
> Learn about its famous residents, like Jay-Z, Walt Whitman, and J.P. Morgan, and discover stories of innovation and struggle which are a part of the Big Apple's fabric.
>
> How do _you_ relate to the vision of generations of immigrants, politicians, tycoons, dreamers, builders, and ordinary New Yorkers?
